mainEntity.name: Does MacBook Pro have a built-in pixel cleaner or screen test?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. macOS does not include a manual Pixel Cleaning, Pixel Refresh, or full-screen uniformity test in System Settings. EvenDisplay gives MacBook users a free 9-color uniformity test, IPS pixel conditioning sweep, and reversible screen band compensator.

mainEntity.name: What MacBook screen issues can EvenDisplay help with?

acceptedAnswer.text: EvenDisplay visually balances dim vertical bands and uneven color casts using a reversible click-through overlay, clears temporary IPS image retention and ghosting with full-screen sweeps, spots stuck or dead pixels, and provides a 2-minute lid-angle hardware diagnostic for MacBook Pro and Air screens.

mainEntity.name: Will EvenDisplay tint my external monitor?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The native macOS app queries CGDisplayIsBuiltin and anchors the overlay exclusively to your built-in MacBook panel.

mainEntity.name: How do I undo everything cleanly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Press Cmd+Option+0 for an instant stock screen, double-click any slider to reset it to default, click Factory Reset in Preferences, or quit/delete EvenDisplay.app. Zero system files are ever modified.
